{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check for the presence of 'loyal' in customer_segment
print("Unique values in customer_segment:", df['customer_segment'].unique())

# Check the distribution of customer_segment
print("\nDistribution of customer_segment:")
print(df['customer_segment'].value_counts().sort_index())

# Check if conversion is indeed 0/1
print("\nValues in 'converted':", df['converted'].unique())

# Verify that all values in 'converted' are 0 or 1
print("\nAny non-0/1 values in 'converted'?", not (df['converted'].isin([0, 1])).all())"}
